Hierarchical composition

456 evaluation cases by environment, motion, scene type, and dataset

Rings, from the inside: environment, static or dynamic scenes, and scene type. Outer bars: evaluation cases per dataset (square-root length), stacked by task. Each scene is placed once: ETH3D and Tanks & Temples are split by scene, and the Marigold suite by subset (NYUv2 indoor, KITTI driving, ETH3D and DIODE mixed). SLAM counts each sequence once per range track it runs in. SpatialArena (highlighted) is captured with a handheld 3-camera LiDAR rig. It counts one case per MonoDepth scene, VideoDepth clip, MVRecon or SfM scene, and SLAM sequence, and each is placed by its scene: rooms, galleries, corridors and platforms are room-scale; a statue or monument walk-around is object-centric; a multi-level museum, facades, a castle and a high-rise plaza are buildings; streets, a canal side, a market square, a station forecourt and plazas are city-scale; the two alleys are small-scale; gardens, a yard and a park are parks. A case is dynamic when people or vehicles cover over 3% of the pixels its camera sees (or appear in over 60% of its frames).

Protocol

Input tracks, metrics, and alignment for every task

Input tracks

A prior is supplied only when it cannot reveal the prediction target. Depth to a depth task, or poses to a pose task, would be circular. VideoDepth’s camera track (◐) runs only on SpatialArena, the one dataset with released ground-truth camera poses.

Metrics and alignment

Why alignment matters

real TUM RGB-D & 7-Scenes trajectories

ATE ratio = ATE after the estimated alignment / ATE after the true one. 1 is exact; below 1 hides error, above 1 inflates it. 540 trials per scenario.

Robust trajectory alignment

Sim(3), pose-aware
1 · RANSACLMedS over 2-frame samples, 25 seeded iterations, pose-aware Levenberg–Marquardt fit.
2 · Inlier refitRefit on frames within 2.5σ of the best sample.
3 · Robust refitCauchy IRLS on all frames; result is independent of the seed.
4 · Collapse guardFall back to a center-only fit if the scale collapses.
Depth alignment
PixelsChosen by the ground truth alone; the prediction never shrinks the set.
SpaceAffine fit in the space each model declares: depth, or inverse depth for disparity models (Lotus-D, DVD, DepthCrafter, GeoNeXt). Metrics are always in depth.
LossHuber (δ = 0.05, relative), solved by IRLS with a convergence test.
ScopeOne fit per image (MonoDepth) or per sequence (VideoDepth).
